user.title: Battery ROI
user.description: Pick sensors from your own setup. Only battery power and price are required; the folded sections are optional.

data_description.charge_power: Power flowing into the battery (W or kW), from any brand: EcoFlow, Zendure, Marstek, Victron, Huawei, SolarEdge… If you only have one signed power sensor, pick it here and leave discharge power empty.
data_description.discharge_power: Power flowing out of the battery. Leave empty when the sensor above is signed.
data_description.positive_means: Only used with a single signed power sensor. Wrong? Profit turns negative while the battery earns: flip this and press Reset totals.

data.price_surcharge: Extra cost per kWh, excluding VAT

data_description.price: Your dynamic tariff sensor: EPEX, Nordpool, ENTSO-e, Tibber, Frank Energie, Zonneplan… EUR/kWh, ct/kWh and EUR/MWh are converted automatically.
data_description.price_surcharge: Only for raw market prices (EPEX, Nordpool): energy tax + supplier fee in EUR/kWh. Leave empty for all-in prices such as Tibber.
data_description.vat: Only for raw market prices: applied to price + extra cost. 21 in the Netherlands. Leave empty for all-in prices.
data_description.feed_in_price: What you get per exported kWh. On many dynamic contracts that is the same market price sensor as above. Only used together with grid power.

data_description.grid_power: Your smart meter or energy monitor (DSMR, HomeWizard P1, Shelly EM, Tibber Pulse…): positive when importing, negative when exporting. With a feed-in price this tells whether the battery avoided buying or selling.

data_description.standby_power: What the battery uses itself (inverter, BMS) that its power sensors don't show. Leave empty if your charge sensor already includes it.
data_description.wear_cost: Degradation in EUR per kWh delivered: purchase cost ÷ (capacity × rated cycles). Counted once per kWh.

error.same_sensor: Charge and discharge power must be different sensors.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Battery ROI is already set up. Use Configure to change sensors.
